actual_paper_preparation.interpretation: Current background operators produced no actual support material on this corpus. Six pairs compare only an added caution and six pairs have no prompt exposure difference. This is evidence of limited natural-paper adaptation, not evidence of improved or degraded model answer quality. Chinese-only querying also exposes the lexical retrieval limitation.
